title: EMEA Regional Brand Manager & Product Specialist, Portal Hypertension - Gore Medical (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description .buttontextc2d360e9261385d1 a{ border:** 1px solid transparent; } .buttontextc2d360e9261385d1 a: focus{ border: 1px dashed \#da291c !important; outline: none !important; }
  
EMEA Regional Brand Manager \& Product Specialist, Portal Hypertension \- Gore Medical (m/f/d)
  
**Req Id:** 2099
  
**State/Province:** Verona
  
**Business:** Gore Medical Products
  
**Category:** Sales \& Marketing
  
**Sub\-Category:** Marketing
  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote
  
**Posting Start Date:** 8/24/26
  
**Posting End Date:** 9/18/26
  
About the Role
  
  

We are looking for an EMEA Regional Brand Manager \& Product Specialist to join our Peripheral Team and lead the Portal Hypertension brand strategy across EMEA. In this role, you will develop and drive the product, marketing, educational, KOL engagement and go\-to\-market strategies for the Portal Hypertension portfolio, ensuring strong product lifecycle management, commercial readiness and sustained leadership in an increasingly competitive market. You will partner closely with Sales, Clinical, Medical Education, Global Marketing, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Finance, Market Access and other regional and local teams to translate EMEA priorities into scalable plans that can be adapted to local market dynamics.
  
  

This position is open to EMEA (f/m/d) and offers fully remote work allowed in most locations within EMEA.
  
  

**Pay and Benefits:**  

€85,000 \- €100,000 per year
  
Factors considered in extending an offer within this pay range include (but not limited to) education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.
  
We offer a comprehensive total rewards package, including competitive benefits. While offerings vary from one country to another, based on local requirements and competitive practice, we strive to offer benefits to meet the diverse needs of our Associates throughout their career with Gore and beyond.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

**Market Insight:** Analyze EMEA market dynamics, clinical pathways, competitor activity, referral patterns and unmet needs in portal hypertension to guide portfolio strategy in direct and indirect markets, prioritization and regional growth opportunities.
  
**Product Strategy:** Develop and execute the EMEA product and commercial strategy for the Portal Hypertension portfolio, protecting product leadership and identifying growth opportunities across diverse local markets.
  
**Technical \& Clinical Expertise:** Serve as the regional product and disease\-state expert, translating technical knowledge, clinical evidence and customer insights into clear guidance for field teams, education, positioning and product lifecycle decisions.
  
**Sales Enablement:** Create and deploy clear messaging, tools and training that help sales teams engage confidently with interventional radiologists and referral stakeholders, including hepatologists and gastroenterologists.
  
**KOL Engagement:** Build and maintain strong, compliant relationships with Key Opinion Leaders in portal hypertension, including interventional radiologists, gastroenterologists and hepatologists, to gather insights and strengthen advocacy.
  
**Education:** Define and drive targeted educational programs for HCPs and field teams, ensuring high\-quality, compliant and clinically relevant content aligned to disease\-state needs and portfolio priorities.
  
**Product Launches:** Develop launch, relaunch and readiness plans including positioning, claims/messaging, training, evidence needs, supply considerations, competitive response and local activation requirements.
  
**Lifecycle Management:** Demand plans, field actions, pricing review processes, enumeration needs
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
**Education:** Master’s degree required
  
**Experience:** Minimum 5 years of proven success in product management and/or marketing management roles, preferably with regional or multi\-country responsibilities.
  
**Industry Knowledge:** Minimum 3 years of product and commercial experience in the portal hypertension market, including deep knowledge of competitive landscape
  
**Customer \& KOL Engagement:** Proven ability to build, maintain and leverage strong relationships with clinical customers and KOLs, including interventional and clinical specialties. established partnership with existing KOL in this field (interventional radiology, gastroenterology and hepatology);
  
**Strategic \& Commercial Skills:** Ability to develop product strategy, go\-to\-market plans, launch readiness plans and commercial activation programs in complex and competitive markets.
  
**Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to influence, align and collaborate across functions, geographies and stakeholder groups without direct authority.
  
**Prioritization:** Strong ability to prioritize effectively in a highly demanding environment while maintaining quality, consistency and strategic focus.
  
**Scientific Literacy:** Ability to read and interpret clinical publications, evidence, disease\-state information and competitive data to inform strategy and education.
  
**Communication Skills:** Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to translate strategy into clear guidance for sales teams and local markets.
  
**Professional Standards:** High ethical standards and strict adherence to compliance, quality and business conduct requirements.
  
Desired Qualifications
  
Experience working with external partners, distributors, clinical education providers or professional societies.
  
Sales experience or strong field\-facing commercial experience.
  
MBA degree
  
  

**What We Offer:** Our success is based on the capability and creativity of our Associates, and we are proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive total rewards program that supports your everyday and helps you build your tomorrow.
  
  

We provide benefits that offer choice and flexibility and promote overall well\-being. And in keeping with our belief that every Associate should share in the collective success of the enterprise; we provide a distinctive Associate Stock Ownership Plan in each country as well as potential opportunities for “profit\-sharing”. Learn more at gore.com/careers/benefits.
  
  

We believe in the strength of a diverse and inclusive workplace. With diverse perspectives, ideas and experiences, we uncover new possibilities and make a greater impact in the world. We are proud of Associates for building on our rich history of innovation, upholding our values and supporting an inclusive work environment where we treat each other and our external partners with fairness, dignity and respect.
  
  

Gore is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applications irrespective of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, ancestry, age, status as a qualified individual with a disability, genetic information, pregnancy status, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, status as a covered veteran, gender identity and expression, and any other characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations.
  
  

Our Talent Acquisition Team welcomes your questions at gore.com/careers/contact

title: Impiegato Customer Service Farmacia
description:
**Posizione:** Specialist Customer Service \- Settore Farmaceutico

**Chi Siamo**  
Siamo l'ufficio commerciale di un'azienda multinazionale leader nel settore farmaceutico impegnata nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella distribuzione di soluzioni terapeutiche innovative. La nostra missione è migliorare la qualità della vita dei pazienti offrendo prodotti sicuri e di alta qualità, supportati da un servizio di eccellenza.  
**Ruolo e Responsabilità**  
La risorsa inserita all'interno dell'ufficio Customer Service dedicato all'area Veneto, Trentino Alto Adige, Friuli Venezia Giulia e si occuperà di gestire l'intero ciclo dell'ordine e di garantire un'assistenza di alto livello a farmacie, grossisti e informatori scientifici.

* **Gestione Ordini:** Inserimento, tracciamento e gestione degli ordini di vendita tramite sistema gestionale.
* **Supporto Clienti:** Assistenza telefonica e via email per informazioni su disponibilità prodotti, stato delle spedizioni e schede tecniche.
* **Gestione Reclami e Resi:** Presa in carico delle segnalazioni relative a difformità di consegna, danneggiamenti o resi, in conformità con le procedure aziendali e le normative vigenti.
* **Interfaccia Interfunzionale:** Collaborazione costante con la logistica, la qualità, la contabilità clienti e la forza vendite per ottimizzare i tempi di evasione.
* **Archiviazione e Documentazione:** Controllo della correttezza della documentazione commerciale e rispetto delle linee guida di farmacovigilanza e buona pratica di distribuzione (GDP).

**Requisiti Richiesti**

* **Titolo di studio:** Diploma o Laurea ad orientamento scientifico, chimico o farmaceutico. Costituisce titolo essenziale.
* **Esperienza:** Almeno 2\-3 anni di esperienza nel ruolo di Customer Service, preferibilmente all'interno di aziende farmaceutiche, nutraceutiche o cosmetiche.
* **Competenze Tecniche:** Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office (in particolare Excel) e familiarità con software ERP e gestionali.
* **Soft Skills:** Eccellenti doti comunicative e relazionali, orientamento al cliente, precisione, capacità di gestione dello stress e attitudine al lavoro di squadra.

**Cosa Offriamo**

* Inserimento in un contesto dinamico, strutturato e in forte crescita.
* Pacchetto retributivo commisurato all'effettiva esperienza del candidato (CCNL Commercio).
* Percorsi di formazione continua e possibilità di crescita professionale.

Retribuzione: €1\.352,47 \- €1\.895,19 al mese

Benefit:

* Parcheggio libero
* Supporto allo sviluppo professionale

Domande di preselezione:

* Hai un titolo di studio in ambito scientifico, chimico o farmaceutico?

Istruzione:

* Scuola Secondaria di II livello (Superiori) (Obbligatorio)

Esperienza:

* customer care in ambito farmaceutico o similare?: 1 anno (Obbligatorio)

Sede di lavoro: Di persona
